whatTheyDo: A full-service renovation and remodeling contractor — single rooms up to whole-home gut renovations, with their own crew start to finish.
areaServed: The North Shore of Long Island: Huntington, Northport, Cold Spring Harbor, Port Washington, and surrounding towns

faqs.a: The North Shore of Long Island: Huntington, Northport, Cold Spring Harbor, Port Washington, and the surrounding towns. If you're nearby, just ask.

faqs.q: Do you handle small remodels and whole-home?
faqs.a: Both. A single bathroom or a full gut down to the studs, same crew, same standard. Tell us the scope and we'll tell you straight.
Yes. Fully licensed and insured, and happy to send proof before any work starts.
Always. We walk the house, talk through what you want, and put a real written number in front of you. No pressure.

faqs.q: How long does a renovation take?
faqs.a: A bathroom is usually a few weeks; a whole-home runs a few months. We give you a real schedule up front and keep you posted as we go.

faqs.q: Do you use your own crew?
faqs.a: Yes, no subs. The people who quote the job are the people doing it. That's how the quality stays consistent.
